scope: All curves are synthetic. This is a teaching replay, not LLM training, a real GPU cost benchmark, or a reproduction of EcoTrain.

protocol.checkpoint_selection: lowest observed raw loss before or at stop
protocol.false_stop_definition: Stopped early without target attainment, while the complete same synthetic curve attains target; retrospective diagnosis only.
protocol.unit_note: Evaluation counts are not training steps, wall-clock time, GPU-hours or energy. Unattained evaluations_to_target is JSON null / CSV null.
